source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a registry of 25 NF1 patients with pheochromocytoma, median age at presentation was 43 years (range 14-61), all disease was adrenal with no paragangliomas, 20% were multifocal and 12% were malignant.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 43 Bausch 2006 PMID 16790714. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 43
